answer: Complimentary breakfast buffet is served daily at The Grand Dining Hall from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM.
High-speed Wi-Fi network is 'SmartStay-Guest'. Your password is your room number + last 4 digits of your phone number.
Standard checkout time is 11:00 AM. Late checkout can be requested via Service Requests on your account dashboard.
Standard check-in time starts at 2:00 PM. Early check-in is subject to room availability.
Your 6-digit room door passcode is available on your Account Dashboard under 'My Passcode' once your booking is checked in.
Our infinity pool and fitness center are open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM on the 5th floor.
